description: This file contains class definitions that facilitate backward compatibility and namespace remapping for the SuiteCRM project. It includes classes that extend core classes related to HTML sanitization and URI handling, with a focus on maintaining legacy support.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_cid
classes.description: A class extending the SuiteCRM HTMLPurifier URI scheme handling for 'cid' scheme, used for backward compatibility in URI processing.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Filter_Xmp
classes.description: A class extending the SuiteCRM HTMLPurifier filter for 'Xmp', ensuring legacy filtering support.

classes.name: SugarCleaner
classes.description: A class extending the SuiteCRM HTML sanitizer for cleaning HTML content.

classes.name: SugarURIFilter
classes.description: A class extending the SuiteCRM URI filter, used for URI validation and filtering.
